group: validate – normal flow (no customizer, no exception)

cases.expected: format.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; executionCustomizer is not invoked; internal validate(executionContext,node) returns a Set<ValidationMessage> called expectedMessages; format.format(this, expectedMessages, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned as the method result.
cases.description: Verifies the happy‑path where no ExecutionContextCustomizer is supplied, validation succeeds without throwing, and the OutputFormat receives the correct validation messages.

cases.expected: format.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; executionCustomizer.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is also invoked exactly once; internal validate returns expectedMessages; format.format(this, expectedMessages, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned.
cases.description: Ensures that when a non‑null ExecutionContextCustomizer is supplied it is called after the format customization and before validation proceeds.

cases.expected: format.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; internal validate throws FailFastAssertionException containing a Set<ValidationMessage> called failFastMessages; the catch block captures the exception and assigns validationMessages = failFastMessages; format.format(this, failFastMessages, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned.
cases.description: Tests the branch where the underlying validation throws FailFastAssertionException; the method must swallow the exception, extract its messages, and forward them to the OutputFormat.

cases.expected: format.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; executionCustomizer.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; internal validate throws FailFastAssertionException with failFastMessages; catch block assigns validationMessages = failFastMessages; format.format(this, failFastMessages, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned.
cases.description: Combines both a non‑null ExecutionContextCustomizer and a FailFastAssertionException to verify that customizer execution occurs before the exception is caught and that the correct messages are still passed to the OutputFormat.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when format.customize(null, validationContext) is invoked.
cases.description: Ensures that passing a null ExecutionContext causes an NPE because the method does not guard against a null executionContext before delegating to the OutputFormat.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when attempting to invoke format.customize(...).
cases.description: Verifies that a null OutputFormat leads to an NPE because the method immediately calls format.customize without null‑checking.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (custom message) propagates out of validate method; format.format is never invoked.
cases.description: Checks that if OutputFormat.customize throws an unchecked exception, the validate method does not catch it and the exception bubbles up.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (custom message) propagates out of validate method after successful validation; format.customize is invoked, internal validation runs, but format.format throws.
cases.description: Ensures that an exception thrown by OutputFormat.format is not swallowed by validate and is propagated to the caller.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (custom message) propagates out of validate method after format.customize has been invoked; format.format is never called.
cases.description: Validates that a RuntimeException thrown by the supplied ExecutionContextCustomizer is not caught by validate and aborts processing.

cases.expected: format.format(this, null, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned.
cases.description: Simulates a scenario where the underlying validate(executionContext, node) method (perhaps overridden in a test subclass) returns null; the method should forward the null set to the OutputFormat without throwing.

group: validate – both customizer and format.customize throw

cases.expected: RuntimeException from format.customize propagates; executionCustomizer.customize is never invoked because the method aborts after the first exception.
cases.description: Confirms the order of operations: format.customize is called first; if it throws, the customizer is not executed.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when internal validate(executionContext, null) is invoked (or earlier when format.customize is called, depending on implementation).
cases.description: Tests the behaviour when the JSON node to validate is null; the method does not perform a null‑check before delegating to the internal validation logic.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or any RuntimeException) propagates out of validate; format.format is never invoked.
cases.description: Simulates a scenario where the internal validate(executionContext, node) method throws a generic RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException). The validate method should not catch it, allowing the exception to bubble up, and should not call format.format.

cases.expected: AssertionError (or any java.lang.Error) propagates out of validate; format.format is never invoked.
cases.description: Ensures that if the internal validation logic throws an Error (e.g., AssertionError), the validate method does not catch it and the error propagates to the caller.

cases.expected: format.customize(executionContext, validationContext) is invoked; internal validate throws FailFastAssertionException whose getValidationMessages() returns null; catch block assigns validationMessages = null; format.format(this, null, executionContext, validationContext) is invoked and its return value is returned.
cases.description: Tests the edge case where FailFastAssertionException is thrown but its payload (validation messages) is null. The method should forward the null set to the OutputFormat without throwing.
